title.hr: Stanja uzbune: na čekanju i aktivna

concept.hr: Pravilo vidi samo uzorke; for traži uvjet bez prekida, pa treperenje ne okida
concept.en: The rule sees only scrapes; for wants an unbroken run, so flapping never fires

summary.hr: Pusti metriku kroz jedno pravilo uzbunjivanja i podešavaj ga: vrijede samo prikupljeni uzorci, for čeka bez prekida, a treperenje okida često ili nikad.
summary.en: Feed a CPU metric to one alerting rule and tune it: only scraped samples count, for waits without a break, and flapping fires often or never.

concept.hr: Bez čekanja svaki skok postaje uzbuna: pet uzbuna u petnaest minuta
concept.en: With no wait every rise becomes an alert: five alerts in fifteen minutes

concept.hr: Pravilo vidi samo prikupljene uzorke: skok koji nitko nije prikupio ne postoji
concept.en: The rule sees only scraped samples: a spike nobody scraped does not exist
